meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 BGPT 服务器搜索科学论文,并返回从全文提取的结构化数据,包括方法、结果、样本量、质量评分和结论,每篇论文含 25 个以上字段。
howto.when: 当用户要求搜索科学论文、做文献综述,或想获取论文摘要里没有的实验细节(如样本量、效果量)时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下关于CRISPR基因编辑效率的论文
say.note: 会调用 search_papers 返回结构化论文数据。

say.text: 找几篇关于抑郁症治疗的系统综述
say.note: 返回带质量评分和结论的文献列表。

say.text: 比较这两篇论文使用的实验方法
say.note: 会提取并对比方法字段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search scientific papers via the BGPT MCP server and return structured data extracted from full-text studies—methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, conclusions, and 25+ fields per paper.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to search scientific papers, conduct a literature review, or retrieve experimental details not found in abstracts (e.g., sample sizes, effect sizes).

say_en.text: Search for papers on CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells.
say_en.note: Calls search_papers and returns structured paper data.

say_en.text: Find systematic reviews on depression treatment.
say_en.note: Returns papers with quality scores and conclusions.

say_en.text: Compare the experimental methods used in these two papers.
say_en.note: Extracts and compares the methods field.
